title: ジャパンCの後に・勇気を与えて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon defeats Tokai Teio at the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she is enveloped by the cheers of the crowd, she's happy to find that she was able to inspire others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio's face is teary as the two of them promise to have a rematch someday.
